properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

user.Description: Azure customer profile metadata used by the partner for JIT provisioning.

singleSignOn.Description: Single sign-on metadata returned by the partner after Organization creation.

defaultWorkspaceId.Description: Partner-issued identifier of the default Workspace for this Organization.

workspaceCount.Description: Total count of Workspaces under this Organization.

organizationName.Description: Display name of the Organization on the partner side.

billingEmail.Description: Billing contact email address for the Organization.

ownerEmail.Description: Initial owner email for the Organization. JIT-provisioned by the partner if the user does not already exist.

defaultWorkspace.Description:
Default Workspace created atomically with the Organization.
Required at create time and immutable thereafter.
After create, manage workspaces (including this default) via the standard
Workspace child resource operations.

name.Description: Display name of the default Workspace.

product.Description: Marketplace product selected for this Workspace.

marketplaceDetails.Description:
Azure Marketplace SaaS subscriptions linked to this Workspace.
At least one entry is required. Mutable to support Marketplace-driven
plan changes.

subscriptionId.Description: Azure subscription id for the the marketplace offer is purchased from

offerDetails.Description: Offer details for the marketplace that is selected by the user

publisherId.Description: Publisher Id for the marketplace offer

offerId.Description: Offer Id for the marketplace offer

planId.Description: Plan Id for the marketplace offer

planName.Description: Plan Name for the marketplace offer

termUnit.Description: Plan Display Name for the marketplace offer

termId.Description: Plan Display Name for the marketplace offer

alternateEmail.Description: Alternate email address of the user.

country.Description: Country or region of the company.

type.Description: Type of Single Sign-On mechanism being used

state.Description: State of the Single Sign On for the resource

enterpriseAppId.Description: AAD enterprise application Id used to setup SSO

url.Description: URL for SSO to be used by the partner to redirect the user to their system

aadDomains.Description: List of AAD domains fetched from Microsoft Graph for user.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
